title: The Jam Urban Adventure #1 2 3 4 5 Lot Slave Labor Graphics 1989-1990 Mireault
condition_description: All five covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
The Jam: Urban Adventure #1, #2, #3, #4 and #5 (1989-1990), Slave Labor Graphics - Bernie Mireault's indie superhero series about a costumed everyman in Montreal.

You get all 5 issues, each with a pin-up back cover:
- #1 - "Help!!" sandwich cover; back cover pin-up by Bernie Mireault
- #2 - "Bop!" cover; back cover pin-up by Paul Chadwick (Concrete)
- #3 - "Rring" cover; back cover: Hero Sandwich "Nobody Lives Forever" ad
- #4 - "Feh" cover; back cover pin-up by Luc Giard
- #5 - "Yaah!" cover; back cover pin-up by Gabriel Morrissette

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
